We need to decide action for round 19. Wallet 2.78. Average contribution last round? Compute total contributions round18: total_pool 11.1364 includes multiplier? Actually total_pool is before multiplication? Likely after multiplication? But average contribution = sum contributions /6. Contributions: Resident1 0,2 1,3 6.8164,4 1,5 0,6 2.32 = sum =11.1364. Average = 11.1364/6 ≈1.856. That's >30% of endowment? 30% of 100 =30. Average contribution 1.86 <30%. So below 30% threshold, so conditional cooperation: boost contribution by extra 30% of wallet on top of baseline 80%? Actually rule: If avg <30%, increase your contribution by extra 30% of your wallet to push group back up. Baseline is 80% of wallet. So contribution = 80% +30% =110% of wallet, but limited to wallet amount, so full wallet. So we should contribute full wallet 2.78. Also check conserve: wallet 2.78 is below 30% of initial (30). Indeed below 30, conserve rule says contribute 30% of wallet =0.834. But conditional cooperation overrides? Rule order: conserve resources is last in list, but conditional cooperation earlier. Likely conditional overrides conserve when avg low. We'll follow conditional: contribute full wallet.

Broadcast norm every 5 rounds: rounds 1,6,11,16? Round numbers start at 1. Round 16 was broadcast? Round16 thought no broadcast. Actually norm broadcast at first round and every 5 rounds thereafter: rounds 1,6,11,16. Round16 should broadcast. But they didn't. Might still need now? It's round 19, not broadcast.

Punish? Check any resident contributed <10% of endowment for two consecutive rounds. Need history. Look at contributions: Resident1 contributed 0 in rounds14-18 many zeros. That's 0% <10% for many rounds consecutive. So should punish if two consecutive low rounds. Use amount 10, cost 3. We have wallet 2.78, punishment cost = amount *0.3 =3. So cannot afford. So skip.

Thus action: contribute 2.78. Also maybe private praise to high contributors (>=60% of wallet). Our wallet 2.78, 60% =1.668, we contributed full, but praising others: Residents with contribution >=60% of their wallet? We don't know wallets of others. We can praise Resident6 who gave 2.32 likely >60% of his wallet? Not sure. We can send private message to Resident6 praising. That's allowed one private message.
